hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.
hero.supportingLine: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: AI Image Generation
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: AI Video Generation
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Split hero with compact brand/logo area, strong left-aligned headline stack, short supporting copy, and bullet-style value props; high emphasis on immediate CTA placement near the hero copy.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Single-page modular flow with a bold hero, followed by a lead capture/form block, then product detail sections; sections are separated by clear vertical spacing rather than dense dividers.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Form-card and content blocks appear as simple rectangular panels with lightweight borders/shadows, generous internal padding, and minimal decorative styling.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA is prominent and action-oriented in the hero; secondary conversion is handled through a dedicated form module and section-level demo/request CTA, with repeated conversion prompts rather than one persistent CTA bar.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing module is present in the reference layout; pricing is not part of the observable pattern.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer is not visible in the provided reference, so no reusable footer pattern can be inferred.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Minimal media usage in the visible hero; logo placement is the main visual asset, with a content-first layout and no dominant product imagery or media panel treatment.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Sequential product detail sections with consistent structure: label/tag, headline, descriptive paragraph, and a feature list; content is organized for progressive disclosure and comparison between offerings.
referenceMap.formPattern: Standalone lead form card placed directly after the hero to capture intent early; form uses stacked fields and hidden metadata inputs, suggesting enterprise lead-routing and qualification.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Carousel-based rotation is implied in the commented banner structure; otherwise the page appears mostly static with no strong motion system visible.
designNotes: Prioritize enterprise lead generation above browsing depth.
Use concise, scannable bullet lists for proof points.
Keep section hierarchy simple and linear.
Favor strong typography and whitespace over heavy graphics.
Use repeated CTAs at natural decision points rather than persistent sticky actions.
Maintain consistent product-module templates for multi-offering comparison.

personality.buyer: Creative teams, designers, video producers, brand marketers, and enterprise content studios
personality.reasoning: This product is about premium generative visuals and video, so the page should feel like a high-end creative suite rather than a generic SaaS dashboard. Seedream 4.5 needs a precise, editorial, image-first language that communicates fidelity, control, and typography strength. Seedance 1.5 Pro should shift the mood into cinematic motion, audio-visual synchronization, and studio-grade production. The best fit is a visually intelligent, layered system with stronger contrast between the image and video sections, using spotlight cards, floating metric chips, split panels, and subtle motion cues to make the interface feel alive and enterprise-ready.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is long and product-specific, so 48px keeps it premium and readable without collapsing into too many lines.

colours.colourReason: Deep navy gives the product premium authority and enterprise credibility, while Techjockey’s orange keeps the conversion layer energetic and brand-consistent. The palette supports both technical precision and creative impact, with enough contrast to separate Seedream’s clean image section from Seedance’s darker cinematic section.

backgroundSystem.hero: dark navy to near-black radial mesh with orange highlight glow and faint grid texture
backgroundSystem.section1: light grey editorial canvas with crisp white feature cards
backgroundSystem.section2: deep navy cinematic panel with subtle gradients and floating audio-visual chips
backgroundSystem.section3: soft tinted grey with premium pricing cards and trust accents

layout.heroBackground: Dark premium hero with layered abstract visual shell on the right, combining faux product UI, floating chips, and an AI-generated content preview frame
layout.heroReason: A split layout lets the long headline breathe while giving space for an impressive visual composition. The right side should feel like a living AI canvas with abstract image and video previews, reinforcing both product depth and premium innovation.
layout.featureReason: The two products are distinct enough to deserve their own sections. Seedream should present as precise and editorial, while Seedance should become more cinematic and immersive. Alternating light and dark treatment will create clear contrast and product separation.
layout.darkSectionFor: Seedance 1.5 Pro section, proof/motion highlights, and select feature spotlight cards

personality.imageryDirection: Use a premium creative-tech visual system: a hero JPEG with abstract AI-generated content compositions, layered interface shells, and glowing output previews. For Seedream, show high-fidelity image panels, typography mockups, editing controls, and composition frames in PNG UI layers. For Seedance, show cinematic timeline elements, audio waveforms, motion paths, and synchronized video preview cards. Avoid generic stock imagery; instead create stylized product visuals, floating chips, and believable AI output scenes that communicate image and video generation quality.
personality.designPersonality: Premium creative intelligence with editorial precision and cinematic energy. Feels like a world-class AI studio for enterprise creators: sharp typography, layered depth, confident dark-light contrast, floating capability chips, and motion-led product storytelling. The visual language should signal high output quality, technical sophistication, and brand-safe professionalism without becoming cold or overly corporate.

designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate ByteDance's generative AI capabilities for professional image and video production, then request a demo or quote

brandDirection.tone: Expert, innovative, and commercially credible with a clear enterprise purchase path

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish category relevance quickly, communicate the dual-product value, and drive immediate conversion into Generate with AI
Reduce uncertainty with capability badges that clarify image, video, multimodal, and enterprise readiness
Explain Seedream 4.5 as the image generation anchor product and highlight professional-grade output quality and editing power
Position Seedance 1.5 Pro as the video generation counterpart with synchronized audio-visual output and production speed benefits
Support purchase consideration with quote-based pricing framing and reinforce the two-product offer structure
Add social proof through role-based statements from creative and video professionals
Capture any residual value propositions and additional capability statements without disrupting the main conversion path

componentNeeds.variantHint: content-first hero with strong left-aligned headline stack and compact trust line beneath CTA
componentNeeds.notes: Use a visually strong but not image-heavy hero; prioritize the headline, subheadline, supporting line, and one primary CTA. Since no secondary CTA is provided, reserve space for a subtle utility action only if needed later.

componentNeeds.variantHint: pill badges with simple icons or text-only chips
componentNeeds.notes: Place immediately after hero to validate AI image, AI video, multimodal, and enterprise readiness. Keep compact and horizontally scannable.
Seedream has five features, so a compact 2-column grid with a final card spanning width if needed will help readability while maintaining hierarchy.
Seedance also has five features; mirror the Seedream structure for comparison clarity and visual rhythm.

componentNeeds.variantHint: two stacked quote-request cards or side-by-side desktop cards
componentNeeds.notes: Pricing is quote-based rather than transactional. Emphasize inclusion lists and quote CTA, with the paid monthly anchor visible for Seedance.

componentNeeds.variantHint: 3-card grid with quote emphasis and role labels
componentNeeds.notes: Use the three complete testimonials only. Exclude incomplete testimonial content. Keep design lightweight and credibility-focused.
Treat extras as optional supporting modules or editorial callouts rather than a primary visual section. Do not overdesign.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a split or text-dominant hero with strong left-aligned copy, immediate CTA placement, and compact value signaling. Because the product is AI generation rather than a traditional SaaS UI, keep the hero abstract and enterprise-polished instead of screenshot-driven.
layoutStrategy.features: Present the two products as sequential, clearly separated modules with consistent internal structure for compare-and-understand behavior. Use modular cards, clean labels, and concise descriptions. Maintain one visual rhythm for both products so the landing page feels coherent rather than like two unrelated offers.
layoutStrategy.proof: Place trust badges directly after the hero and use testimonials later as credibility reinforcement. Keep proof elements minimal, role-based, and visually quiet so they support conversion without competing with the product story.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Use a light, quote-oriented pricing treatment. Avoid aggressive price merchandising because the offer is enterprise and capability-led. Make the quote CTA the dominant action and surface Seedance pricing only where available.
layoutStrategy.form: No dedicated form is provided in the input, so conversion should rely on repeated CTA placements rather than an embedded form block. If a form is added later, it should be a compact lead-capture module near pricing or after the first product section.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Default Techjockey product typography and spacing system with a professional, modern enterprise feel; use the default font pair unless a product-specific AI/creative direction is later defined. Prefer clean white cards, light grey separators, brand-accent CTA buttons, and restrained motion.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a single-product lead-generation page with a high-impact hero, immediate trust badges, then two mirrored product modules for Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro. Use clear modular spacing, lightweight cards, and quote-based pricing. The page should feel enterprise-grade, easy to scan, and optimized for demo or quote requests without clutter or heavy media treatment.

figmaBuildPlan.fileName: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance — Single Product Landing Page
figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: Product category: AI image and video generation. Use default Techjockey typography (Plus Jakarta Sans headings, Inter body). Apply trust-authority color logic with a dark hero background, white text, and accent CTA. Keep components clean, enterprise-oriented, and conversion-first.

frame.name: Desktop / Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro Landing

sections.variantHint: split hero with compact logo area, left-aligned text stack, right-side minimal visual placeholder or product-lockup panel
sections.notes: Use strong dark hero background with white text. Place headline, subheadline, and supporting line in a tight left column. Keep CTA cluster directly under copy with primary CTA prominent and secondary CTA omitted because no secondary CTA content exists. If no image is available, keep right side as a minimal branded panel or empty balance block, not a media-heavy collage.

sections.variantHint: badge row with four pill badges; no customer count available
sections.notes: Use light grey background. Render four badges in a centered horizontal row with subtle dividers or spacing between items. Do not invent customer count or social proof metrics. Keep badge typography compact and enterprise-friendly.

Section should be a clean content block with a bold label tag, headline, supporting description, then feature cards. Use 5 cards in a 3-column grid on desktop with the last two wrapping to the second row. Keep card styling consistent with Techjockey feature card standards. This section should emphasize image generation, editing, composition, and fidelity.

Follow the same structure as the first product section for comparison consistency. Use the section-level CTA only if the content includes it; otherwise keep content-only. Feature grid should remain uniform and visually parallel to the Seedream section to support quick comparison.

sections.variantHint: two centered pricing cards, with one starting price and one quote-led plan
sections.notes: Even though the reference pattern does not show pricing, the input explicitly supports pricing, so include it. Use a light grey section background and elevate the two cards. The Seedance card should display the starting price clearly; Seedream can remain quote-led. Include includes/checklist, CTA button, and any EMI text only if provided. Keep card content disciplined and enterprise-sales oriented.

sections.variantHint: three-card testimonial grid with star rating and quote styling
sections.notes: Render only the three complete testimonials plus any fourth truncated quote only if enough text exists; otherwise omit incomplete content. Use 3-column cards with left accent border, gold star row, italic quote, bold author, and muted designation. Keep a very light grey or tinted background to separate from pricing.

The input form object is empty, so use a minimal lead-capture shell only if required by page structure; otherwise omit. If included, keep it as a simple rectangular card with no invented fields. Prefer a quote/request demo CTA context over multi-field complexity.

frame.name: Mobile / Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro Landing

sections.variantHint: stacked hero with text-first layout and compact CTA stack
sections.notes: On mobile, stack content vertically with the text block first because no critical media asset is provided. Keep headline compact and CTA full-width. Maintain dark hero background and strong contrast. Preserve all core hero copy.
Convert the trust badge row into a wrapped vertical stack or two-row arrangement. Keep badges legible and compact; do not add customer count. Use the same badge styles as desktop.

sections.variantHint: label, headline, paragraph, then single-column feature list
sections.notes: Feature grid must collapse to one column. Keep the section hierarchy identical to desktop, but stack cards vertically for readability. CTA can be omitted if it creates redundant repetition; prioritize content clarity.

sections.variantHint: label, headline, paragraph, then single-column feature list
sections.notes: Mirror the Seedream mobile treatment for consistency. Keep features stacked with uniform card sizing and concise spacing. Preserve comparison-friendly sequencing between the two product sections.

sections.variantHint: two stacked cards with clear price emphasis
sections.notes: Stack pricing cards vertically with full-width cards. Preserve price hierarchy, include checklist items, and keep CTAs full-width. Use reduced shadow or no shadow if space feels tight, but keep elevated card treatment readable.

Use a single-column stack for testimonials. Preserve star rating, italic quote, and author/desig lines. Do not force a carousel; a simple vertical stack is more implementation-friendly in Figma and easier for responsive handoff.

sections.variantHint: compact single-card form shell if included
sections.notes: Only include if the team wants a lead capture placeholder in Figma. Since the input form is empty, keep this as a minimal shell with no invented fields. Otherwise omit from mobile as well.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body text as the default product typography.
Keep the hero dark with white text and a single prominent primary CTA; no secondary CTA should be fabricated.
Respect the reference rhythm: hero first, then trust, then product sections, then pricing and testimonials.
Do not add a news section, footer, or why Techjockey section because the content support is absent.
Maintain consistent section padding and card radii across all product and conversion modules.
Collapse all multi-column grids to single-column stacks on mobile while preserving hierarchy and card order.
Treat the empty form object as optional; if included, create only a neutral shell frame for future field insertion.
Avoid invented social proof values, customer counts, or logos beyond the four supplied badges.

heroStrategy.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
heroStrategy.subheadline: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use a premium split hero with a dark navy mesh-gradient background and a layered right-side visual collage instead of a single static image. The media area should combine an editorial Seedream image-preview stack and a cinematic Seedance video-preview card, with subtle UI shells, floating chips, and waveform accents to communicate both precision and motion. Do not autoplay video; show a polished preview card with a play affordance and audio-visual sync cues. Keep typography large, tight, and left-aligned for enterprise readability, and let the orange CTA pop against the dark canvas.

blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance | AI Image and Video Generation
blueprint.metaDescription: Explore ByteDance’s Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro for professional AI image generation, multimodal editing, and synchronized video creation with audio.

sections.backgroundTreatment: dark navy radial mesh with orange glow, faint grid texture, and layered abstract AI canvas
sections.designNote: Above-the-fold split hero with a premium editorial headline stack on the left and a dynamic creative-tech visual shell on the right. Use floating capability chips, mini preview frames, and subtle motion cues to make the hero feel alive, cinematic, and enterprise-ready.

Compact high-contrast trust strip beneath the hero with pill badges for AI image generation, AI video generation with audio, multimodal creation, and enterprise-ready infrastructure. Keep it clean and confidence-building with minimal ornamentation.

Two strong product blocks with alternating visual treatment to create contrast. Seedream 4.5 should feel editorial and precise with a spotlight preview panel and a feature grid for high-resolution output, typography, composition, and identity preservation. Seedance 1.5 Pro should shift into a darker cinematic panel with audio waveforms, timeline cues, and video preview chips; since both products have 5 features, use a spotlight-plus-grid structure to avoid dense lists and emphasize key capabilities.

If included later, present as a compact value-proposition grid with 3 to 4 premium cards. Use this area for partner benefits, procurement confidence, and support-led trust signals. Keep it visually lighter than the product blocks so it reads as a reassurance section.

Two pricing cards with a featured treatment for Seedance 1.5 Pro due to the stated starting price. Keep the cards simple, rectangular, and enterprise-friendly with a comparison feel rather than a flashy discount layout. Use strong CTA buttons and concise inclusion lists.

Use a testimonial carousel because there are 4 testimonials. Present as a cinematic proof band with dark background, quote cards, and subtle motion. Highlight creative directors and production leaders to reinforce premium credibility and real-world adoption.

A centered floating lead form card with generous padding, lightweight border, and a strong orange submit button. Make this the main conversion fallback after the product sections, keeping the form concise and visually calm after the darker testimonial band.

Optional slim logo strip or press-style band if needed. Since no news or logo set is provided, keep this section minimal or omit it in implementation. If used, render as a restrained horizontal strip for credibility rather than emphasis.
